parameters.name: AddInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to be added in this rule update. This parameter does not need to be passed if there are no instances to add.

parameters.name: DeleteInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to be removed in this rule update. This parameter does not need to be passed if there are no instances to remove.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
Rule ID.
> You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListCheckRule](~~2590599~~) API.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
Rule type. Default is **WHITE**. Values:
- **WHITE**: Add to whitelist

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The scope of effect for modifying the rule:
- **INSTANCE**: Instance
- **ITEM**: Check item

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-check-rule --rule-id 900000 --rule-type WHITE --add-instance-list InstanceId=i-wz9g8ljygfqs1ez30000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --delete-instance-list InstanceId=i-8vb0e8qdaj0yyxjo0000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --remark testRemark --scope-type INSTANCE --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyCheckRule --region cn-hangzhou --ScopeType INSTANCE --AddInstanceList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DeleteInstanceList.1.InstanceId 'i-8vb0e8qdaj0yyxjo0000' --AddInstanceList.1.InstanceId 'i-wz9g8ljygfqs1ez30000' --RuleId 900000 --RuleType WHITE --DeleteInstanceList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Remark testRemark
